phrases.text: By the fig and the olive ˹of Jerusalem˺
Indeed, We created humans in the best form
phrases.ar: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الإنْسَانَ فِي أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ

phrases.text: But We will reduce them to the lowest of the low ˹in Hell˺
except those who believe and do good
they will have a never-ending reward
Now, what makes you deny the ˹final˺ Judgment
phrases.head: The statement concerning the interpretation of His word, the Exalted: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِالدِّينِ ("What then makes you deny the Judgment?") (7)

phrases.text: Is Allah not the most just of all judges
